method: Native Chromium touch emulation; software WebGL; pause-assisted screenshots. Not physical-device performance or human-feel evidence.
completion: Completed exactly two actual terminal attempts, both losses. Parent authorized new normal browser session for attempt2 after supplied driver blocked end-menu scrolling.

rating_reasons.overall_mobile: Attractive FPS with usable touch movement, firing and receiver interactions; two memories recovered on second attempt. Offscreen map and restart controls materially undermine landscape usability.
rating_reasons.controls: Movement, fire, reload and jump responded; aim and movement coordination remained difficult for this reviewer. No physical-thumb ergonomics claim.
rating_reasons.gameplay: Memory recovery gives tangible health/ammo relief and second run progressed substantially farther. Patrol pressure punished navigation mistakes; boss and final balance untested.
rating_reasons.presentation: Strong rainy station atmosphere, weapon silhouette and consistent cyan/amber language.
rating_reasons.usability: Map close control and terminal restart outside 844x390 viewport. Map recoverable via pause; end screen not recoverable using supplied touch driver.
rating_reasons.readability: Health/ammo and objective labels readable; small instruction/HUD text and clipped panels reduce useful landscape information.

attempts.observations: Held FIRE to kill induction guard. Reloaded, advanced toward west archive; repeatedly met rail/wall geometry. Tried jump and lateral movement. Opened map, recovered via visible pause button, resumed movement and attempted aim/fire escape before death.
recoveries: Visible top-right pause button dismissed planning view into pause; Resume restored play.
mistakes: Approached west archive too directly and met cover/walls.
Did not successfully turn and address flanking attackers before death.

attempts.fresh_run: Normal title Deploy in new browser session after explicit close, exit and exact PID absence verified for prior session. Parent authorized workaround.
attempts.observations: Flanked farther left successfully into west archive. Overshot receiver, aimed and fired unsuccessfully at sentinel, returned and recovered Mara. Shield regenerated while moving away from attackers. Moved to Heart and recovered Sera with held USE. Turned east toward final archive; met vaultable cover, attempted jump and forward movement, died from incoming fire before reaching Elian.
recoveries: Mara restored health from38 to58 and shield to30, plus ammo.
Sera restored health58 to78 and shield60.
Reload restored rifle after near-empty magazine.
Moved away from attackers to regenerate shield.
mistakes: Overshot receiver by several metres and spent time returning.
Fired poorly at sentinel (only one elimination total).
Moved into cover blocking direct eastward passage.
Did not eliminate warden/patrol threats before crossing exposed area.
